title_as_printed: Densities rho for the near-saturated CO2-rich phase of (CO2 + H2O) measured using the upper VTD at temperature T_VTD and pressure p when the phase was saturated at the same pressure but at temperature T_sat. Also listed is the combined standard uncertainty of each density measurement u_c(rho), which combines in quadrature the propagated uncertainties associated with T, p, sampling, and the measured resonance period.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Standard uncertainties in temperature and pressure are u(T) = 0.2 K and u(p) = 0.05 MPa.

row_regime_overrides.reason: Rows with T_sat < 304 K and rho > 600 kg/m3: the CO2-rich phase is a liquid (density 748-1023 kg/m3, jump from vapour-like densities at lower pressure at the same T_sat).

pressure_note: 'pressure p' as measured by strain-gauge transducers on the syringe pumps, standard uncertainty 0.05 MPa; system pressure of the saturated two-phase cell (total pressure, not a gas partial pressure)

T.what: temperature of the density measurement (upper VTD, about 1-2 K above the saturation temperature to avoid water condensation)

T_sat.what: temperature at which the CO2-rich phase was saturated with water at pressure p

value.what: density of the near-saturated, water-bearing CO2-rich phase (water content not measured)

composition.other_species: CO2-rich phase (CO2 purity 0.9995 mole fraction) near-saturated with water vapour; no salt

notes: Printed in two side-by-side panels (left first, then right), stacked in that order: 128 rows. The measured density is of a phase saturated at T_sat but measured at T_VTD (1-2 K higher), so it is a near-saturated, not exactly saturated, density; the paper's own T for the measurement is T_VTD, mapped to T. Water content of this phase is not reported in the table. Property 'other': density of the water-bearing CO2-rich gas/liquid phase; the builder decides.
